editorial.blurb: Alla Vita brings the warmth and care of Italian cooking to Chicago's West Loop, where thoughtfully crafted pasta and a genuinely welcoming team make every visit feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation well in advance—they fill up quickly—and try to snag the patio in warmer months for an especially charming experience; if you visit during restaurant week, the fixed menu offers great value on their standout pasta dishes.
signatureDishes: Ricotta dumplings with cacio e pepe
